verdict.rationale: Background automation is a fair axis for a desktop operating system, but the evidence pack never documents a way for users to create autonomous background automations. The only related items are default system services (fstrim, earlyoom/systemd-oomd), which are preconfigured behaviors rather than user-defined automations, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
